answer: To keep fake identities from flooding the market, a new agent may only join after it is grafted onto an existing endorsement vine: three established, unlinked sponsors must publicly countersign the admission, and each sponsor may endorse only two newcomers per epoch. A private whisper among sockpuppets is worthless because endorsements are posted on-ledger and the sponsor is slashed if the newcomer later fails uniqueness checks. A rotating raven auditor flags tightly clustered sponsor graphs and freezes those clusters from grading until they diversify.
